notes: Next.js 16 standalone server (.next/standalone/server.js) started by .ui-capture/start.sh on PORT (4401) with GETIT_DATA_DIR=.ui-capture/data (file-based JSON store). Node 20.19.5 pinned in mise.toml. Rebuild: .ui-capture/build.sh; reseed: .ui-capture/seed.sh (it starts the app on port 5401, uploads documents through /api/upload — the 5 bundled sample PDFs plus 8 Markdown lecture notes rendered to PDF by the app's own importer — runs the real detection and viz jobs via the fake codex, then writes the knowledge-graph, study journal and dates in the app's on-disk schema). Data: a 2nd-year Biomedical Engineering student at Politecnico di Milano, using the app from Sep 8 to Nov 15 2026. 13 documents (neurophysiology, membrane transport, enzyme kinetics, Fourier transform, eigenvalues, Bayes (Italian), thermodynamics, microeconomics (Italian, just uploaded and never opened), plus anatomy/physics/calculus/chemistry/costituzione samples). Each opened doc has inline concept tags with ready visualizations (3D molecules/heart/cell, 2D animations, KaTeX formula walkthroughs, graphs, cited-source cards), one failed viz on thermodynamics, some still un-generated; knowledge graphs with 6-10 nodes and mixed mastery scores (Costituzione and Microeconomia have none); chat threads, flashcard decks with ratings (one unfinished), graded quizzes and Feynman sessions with summaries. Welcome popups already dismissed. Main areas: Library (/library), Upload (/), Viewer (/viewer/<docId>) with PDF + tag pills on the left and the right pane (Visualizer, Knowledge graph, Chat, Flashcards, Quizzes, Feynman), Settings popover and Account popover (Codex Plus limits) in the top bar.
